title: VSift setup rollback data v1
description: The data of a complete setup.rollback result (P13 PR 6, ADR 0023). Without --version the component returns to the version its selection records as selected before; with --version it selects that installed version. Either way the version is selected only after it verifies (its manifest exists and every file matches it; a return to the recorded previous version also requires the manifest recorded), in one atomic rename, and the version it replaced becomes the new previous one, so a second rollback returns. status is rolled_back, or already_selected when the named version was already the verified selection and nothing changed. A refusal (nothing installed, no such or earlier version, a version that does not verify, another command holding the managed folder) is a failure result and changes nothing. No path.
